name: magpie-plugin-recode
description: ReCode (recode.cat) accounts as magpie Library rows (claude#rec-<id>) that follow Claude Code's MCP servers, skills, instructions and CLAUDE.md, with optional sessions shared across accounts, and a panel in magpie's window

summary.en: ReCode accounts as Library rows (claude#rec-<id>) that follow Claude Code's MCP servers, skills, instructions and CLAUDE.md; optionally one shared sessions folder for every account; a panel in magpie's window shows each account.
summary.zh: ReCode 的每个账号成为 Library 的 claude#rec-<id> 行，跟随 Claude Code 的 MCP、skill、说明和 CLAUDE.md；可选所有账号共用一个会话文件夹；magpie 窗口里有面板看每个账号的情况。
